missed_signal_check.note: Explicitly included decision-model/Jev discovery so fast non-generative decision models are not missed by story-led discovery.

queries: frontier model and original technical research announcements
frontier and smaller-lab model releases including Jev/System One
open-source agent runtimes, harnesses and decision components
current GitHub/Hugging Face agent and harness work
current agents, decision models, enterprise workflows, safety and interfaces
current official and creator AI-agent video indexes
independent evaluations of emerging model classes and agent mechanisms

findings: Gemini 4 Argon is a material model release but not by itself a new cross-cutting Watchlist mechanism.
Persistent Runtime Instances strengthen the existing long-horizon-agent signal.
Codex Cloud remains relevant but does not establish a new mechanism beyond existing harness/cloud-agent topics.
No sufficiently distinct new interface mechanism admitted today.
AWS DevOps Agent Skills add new evidence to reusable governed skills.
OpenShell/Open Agent Safety remains an existing updated signal; no separate new topic admitted.
Decision-specific models and emerging decider components were reviewed separately from LLM/chat releases.

candidate_ledger.name: Fast structured decision models for agent control loops
candidate_ledger.mechanism: specialized non-generative models map state plus typed questions to structured probabilistic decisions for routing, approval, scoring and other high-volume control-loop judgments
candidate_ledger.rationale: Jev establishes a distinct decision-first model class, an independent 37-dataset evaluation supplies non-vendor evidence, and follow-on decider products from major AI vendors indicate the mechanism is becoming a broader ecosystem pattern rather than a one-off launch.
candidate_ledger.limitations: Jev remains proprietary and specialized; independent results show strengths but also threshold/calibration and task-dependent limitations. Follow-on vendor products require their own validation.

candidate_ledger.name: Persistent infrastructure for multi-agent workflows
candidate_ledger.mechanism: multi-day agent sessions with durable storage and shared session identity
candidate_ledger.rationale: Bedrock AgentCore Runtime Instances add infrastructure-level evidence for agents that persist across long-running multi-agent workflows.

candidate_ledger.name: Operational know-how encoded as reusable agent skills
candidate_ledger.mechanism: focused reusable instructions with explicit activation descriptions and composable operational procedures
candidate_ledger.rationale: AWS DevOps Agent Skills provide a distinct operational implementation of reusable agent skills, including activation guidance and MCP-tool usage.

candidate_ledger.name: Gemini 4 Argon frontier model
candidate_ledger.rationale: Material frontier-model update, but a model release alone is not admitted as a durable cross-cutting Watchlist mechanism.

candidate_ledger.name: Verified enterprise context for people and agents
candidate_ledger.rationale: Strong enterprise knowledge-quality signal, but more cross-vendor evidence is needed before creating a durable Watchlist mechanism.

candidate_ledger.name: Zero-copy governed data activation for agents
candidate_ledger.rationale: UiPath/Snowflake and current storage-vendor announcements suggest a pattern, but evidence is still dominated by vendor integration launches.

candidate_ledger.name: External runtime controls for agents
candidate_ledger.rationale: Current evidence reinforces the topic but does not add a distinct new mechanism beyond the September 30 update.
